summary.text: Lindee Brill is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 27 and is the only candidate listed for the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Lindee Brill earned a high school diploma from Oostburg High School and a bachelor's degree from Hope College.
She defeated Kay Ladson in the November 5, 2024 general election for Assembly District 27.

For 2025-2026 she is vice-chair of the Mental Health Committee and sits on the Children and Families, Consumer Protection, Constitution and Ethics, Education, and State and Federal Relations committees.
